name: LS_34269_HK_Street.wav
description:
A street in Hong Kong. (binaural, please use headset for 3D effect) 
I recorded this binaural audio file in a street of Hong Kong. You can hear traffic, sounds from the stoplights, pedestrians passing by while talking, and other typical sounds from this city. 
Recorded in February 2019 with an Olympus LS-3 and Ohrwurm 3D binaural microphones. 
Fade in/out and high pass filter at 60Hz -6dB/oct applied in Audacity.
